findings.title: seedPlans endpoint not wired in SubscriptionsController
findings.detail: The task requires seedPlans as a callable endpoint of SubscriptionsModule. The service method seedPlans() exists at subscriptions.service.ts:236 but SubscriptionsController has no handler that invokes it. Without this endpoint the Starter, Professional, and Enterprise subscription plans cannot be seeded via the API.
findings.correction: Add a POST handler (e.g. POST subscriptions/plans/seed) in SubscriptionsController that calls this.subscriptionsService.seedPlans() and restricts access with a suitable guard.
